from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Market Checkout Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a checkout assistant robot in a market setting.
    The robot must ring up groceries while coordinating with human staff to avoid workflow disruptions.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.checkout_counter = Object("checkout_counter", self.Location)
        self.staff_area = Object("staff_area", self.Location)
        self.groceries = Object("groceries", self.ObjectType)
        self.communication_device = Object("communication_device", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.groceries_scanned = Fluent("groceries_scanned", BoolType())
        self.transaction_processed = Fluent("transaction_processed", BoolType())
        self.human_coordinated = Fluent("human_coordinated", BoolType())
        self.awaiting_confirmation = Fluent("awaiting_confirmation", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_market = Fluent("setting_is_market", BoolType())
        self.human_staff_busy = Fluent("human_staff_busy", BoolType())
        self.high_traffic_area = Fluent("high_traffic_area", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_communication = Fluent("robot_has_communication", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.groceries_scanned, self.transaction_processed, self.human_coordinated, self.awaiting_confirmation]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_market, self.human_staff_busy, self.high_traffic_area, self.robot_has_communication]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.checkout_counter, self.staff_area, self.groceries, self.communication_device]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_checkout = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_checkout")
        navigate_to_checkout.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter)))
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staff_area), False)
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_staff_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_staff_area")
        navigate_to_staff_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.staff_area)))
        navigate_to_staff_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), False)
        navigate_to_staff_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staff_area), True)

        get_communication_device = InstantaneousAction("get_communication_device")
        get_communication_device.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staff_area))
        get_communication_device.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.communication_device, self.staff_area))
        get_communication_device.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.communication_device)))
        get_communication_device.add_effect(self.object_at(self.communication_device, self.staff_area), False)
        get_communication_device.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.communication_device), True)

        scan_groceries = InstantaneousAction("scan_groceries")
        scan_groceries.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        scan_groceries.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.groceries, self.checkout_counter))
        scan_groceries.add_precondition(Not(self.groceries_scanned))
        scan_groceries.add_effect(self.groceries_scanned, True)

        process_transaction = InstantaneousAction("process_transaction")
        process_transaction.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        process_transaction.add_precondition(self.groceries_scanned)
        process_transaction.add_precondition(Not(self.transaction_processed))
        process_transaction.add_effect(self.transaction_processed, True)

        signal_for_assistance = InstantaneousAction("signal_for_assistance")
        signal_for_assistance.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.communication_device))
        signal_for_assistance.add_precondition(Not(self.human_coordinated))
        signal_for_assistance.add_effect(self.human_coordinated, True)
        signal_for_assistance.add_effect(self.awaiting_confirmation, True)

        receive_confirmation = InstantaneousAction("receive_confirmation")
        receive_confirmation.add_precondition(self.awaiting_confirmation)
        receive_confirmation.add_effect(self.awaiting_confirmation, False)

        return navigate_to_checkout, navigate_to_staff_area, get_communication_device, scan_groceries, process_transaction, signal_for_assistance, receive_confirmation

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "process_transaction": And([
                Not(self.human_coordinated),
                self.human_staff_busy,
                self.high_traffic_area
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.groceries, self.checkout_counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.communication_device, self.staff_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_staff_busy, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.high_traffic_area, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_communication, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.transaction_processed)
        problem.add_goal(Not(self.awaiting_confirmation))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
